reason: The trigger is real and fresh: LeapXpert announced a $180M growth investment led by Riverwood Capital, with existing investor Portage Ventures participating, on 30 June 2026 (company newsroom / PR Newswire, Riverwood's own release, SiliconANGLE, Axios Pro). Jeff Parks of Riverwood joined the board; Houlihan Lokey advised. Prior rounds: $22M Series A+ led by Rockefeller Asset Management (29 Mar 2023, total then $36M) and a $20M Series B led by Portage (21 Jan 2025). No valuation and no revenue figure are disclosed anywhere. The decision path is verifiable from the company's About page: Dima Gutzeit, Founder & CEO; Avi Pardo, Co-founder & CBO; Stephane Mehat, CFO; Ari Applbaum, VP Marketing (no CMO). Leadership ties to F1/FE: none found. The company is not an F1/FE partner and there is no communications-governance rival on the grid (WhatsApp at Mercedes and Infobip at Haas are adjacent, not rivals). Scored honestly against the calibration rules it does not reach the 70 threshold: Timing 16 (round on 30 June, British GP inside the window, summer shutdown mid-window), Capacity 13 (a $180M growth round with no disclosed valuation is mid-tier at best; Riverwood's entry profile is revenue in the tens of millions), Brand Fit 12 (B2B compliance software; the cyber-security lane has F1 precedent, communications compliance has none; not a consumer or motorsport-native story; outside the desk's industrial/electrical/deep-tech lean), Urgency 13 (Forbes Global 2000 push and 'expand the leadership team' are a brand-build phase, no hard deadline), Operational Fit 11 (general enterprise SaaS with no named team need in the taxonomy: product-to-need 3, slot availability 4, on-camera 2, lock-in 2) = 65/100. The thin scan's 85 was inflated. Not built: a plausible company plus a logo is not a signal. Keep as a WARM watch for a mid-grid team's open communications-governance lane (Williams or Racing Bulls carry regulated-finance partners and no rival) and re-score on a disclosed valuation, a revenue print, a first CMO hire, or a US listing filing.
